title: Theme-Me
description: A highly popular styling utility designed to transform the default Termux environment. Features custom color palettes, font integrations, and automated environment setups for an elevated CLI experience.

title: Project-Chordiz
description: A crowdsourced guitar chord platform built as a final thesis project. Features functional gamification, automated moderator rotation, and a strict meritocracy system powered by Django.

title: SPPK-PA Expert System
description: A clinical decision support system for school counselors. Uses a Forward Chaining inference engine to automate preliminary psychological screening of students, reducing manual assessment time significantly.

title: DinoKing
description: A casual endless runner game for Android, developed using the Godot 4 Engine. Features dynamic obstacles, an integrated shop system, and offline local save data.

title: WestLombok
description: A dynamic tourism destination catalog for West Lombok Regency. Features interactive animations powered by Anime.js and a robust backend built with Django and Unfold admin.

title: ArPy
description: A lightweight yet powerful Python obfuscation utility designed for source code protection. Employs advanced encryption techniques to secure intellectual property against reverse engineering.

title: RandomWeeks
description: A minimalist personal blog platform designed as a space for writing about random ideas, feelings, and the little things that make life feel real.
